implementation: Manual Default for public ActionState returns Self(ActionKind::Idle). ActionKind is a private non-generic enum with unit Idle variant.
remedy: Add standard #[derive(Default)] to private ActionKind and #[default] on Idle, then standard derive Default on ActionState and remove its manual Default553-557. Keep custom Deserialize507-551 unchanged.
semantic_comparison: Both defaults construct identical ActionState(ActionKind::Idle); enum unit default has no payload defaults and the wrapper has no generics or added trait bounds. Private ActionKind gains only an internal implementation; public ActionState::default API and serde behavior remain identical. No configured defaults, normalization, allocation or error policy occurs in this implementation.
